race.comment: AREESEA (6) ran on well enough here 2 weeks ago, and before that was runner-up by a neck at Illawarra Grange. Having Keagan Latham back in the saddle is a positive, and from a good draw, he should go close to winning this. CLOSE COMBAT (4) has been showing some promise at the trials and was close up in the most recent of 2 this season at Rosehill. Follow any market confidence. ZOUSARI (8) has an experience edge over some of his rivals, and he would cope with a wet track better than most if the rain arrives. Each way. OAKFIELD BISMARCK (5) makes his debut from the coveted pole position, and top hoop Aaron Bullock keeps the ride from his most recent trial. Keep him safe in all combos.
